subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella remain open until the Anthropic signed-thinking prevention policy lands, or should maintainers make a narrower issue such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 canonical now that recovery carriers landed?
rationale: The recovery fixes are on main, but the remaining prevention path changes Anthropic replay semantics and has multiple open candidate PRs with compatibility and provider-behavior tradeoffs that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until one prevention PR lands or maintainers explicitly split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after posting a handoff to the selected remaining issue and its chosen PR.

options.title: Defer Prevention Policy
options.body: Treat the merged recovery fixes as sufficient for now and leave prevention to a later provider replay design review.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until one prevention PR lands or maintainers explicitly split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already commented on the recovery split and is the clearest routing candidate in the discussion for deciding whether to keep or split this umbrella.
